target_customer: AI-first teams and startups that want their AI agents to have shared company context
problem: AI agents and employees lack shared, up-to-date company context scattered across Slack, docs, email and calendars. Hyper builds a self-maintaining knowledge graph and injects it into the AI tools people already use.
business_model: SaaS subscription with a free trial; paid design pilots under discussion
product_category: Company brain, agent memory and knowledge graph

founders.name: Shalin Shah
founders.background_notes: YC page says he led autonomy at Matic and built an app for blind users with 3M+ users in high school.

founders.name: Kanyes Thaker
education: UC Berkeley (CS and math, class of 2021)
founders.background_notes: Autonomy lead at Matic, forward-deployed engineer at Snorkel AI per YC page.

competitors.name: Glean
competitors.what: Enterprise search and company knowledge platform

technical_complexity.rationale: Memory system with episodes and facts layers and a knowledge graph over many connectors. The company claims SOTA on public memory benchmarks, which is self-reported.

defensibility.rationale: Many memory and company-brain products exist; moat depends on accumulated company context and integrations.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Platform vendors and enterprise search players were moving into memory and context at the time; the outcome is not yet known.

market_need_then: Agentic development was growing in 2026 and teams needed shared context. Launch signals from the company: top 5 on Hacker News and top 12 on Product Hunt, 50+ teams onboarded and about $1k MRR in 12 days (self-reported in the YC profile).

branding.domain_note: Uses heyhyper.ai with a hey prefix; hyper.ai belongs to another party

identity.mascot_or_character: Retro-futuristic cartoon characters of tomorrow, no named mascot
identity.visual_style: Playful, signature Hyper-orange with lavender and mauve backgrounds and a breeze motif
identity.voice_and_tone: Upbeat and casual, exclamations like Zoom!Zoom!

branding.community_and_virality: Launch HN and Product Hunt placements per YC profile and search results

brand_strength.rationale: Distinct playful visual identity for an infrastructure product, but the name is generic and shared with many unrelated Hyper products and companies.

outcome_analysis: Hyper is a two-person Spring 2026 company with strong autonomy and ML engineering backgrounds whose launch drew Hacker News and Product Hunt attention. No funding round beyond the standard YC deal was verified, and no exit or distress was found. The memory and company brain space is crowded, so the outcome is too early to call.
notes: Only an aggregator (FundedIQ) reports a $500k pre-seed in June 2026; unverified and not recorded as a round. Other Hyper funding results (e.g. $6.3M seed in 2025 for a 911 voice company) are a different company. Website footer lists The Soda Machine Co. as copyright holder; no source explains it. Yc page lists team size 2 and the launch metrics are the company's own.
